title.narrative: Expanding the access to integrated SRHR, GBV and MHPSS services for vulnerable women and girls in Magway, Sagaing, Mandalay, Shan, Kayah, Kayin and Tanintharyi

description.narrative: This project will expand availability of and access to integrated sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR), mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) and gender-based violence (GBV) response services in Magway, Sagaing, Mandalay, Shan, Kayah, Kayin and Tanintharyi, which are affected by the deteriorating humanitarian situations as well as natural disasters. By ensuring the service availability, the project aims to meet the critical needs of women and girls, including those with disabilities, and ensure protection, comprehensive well-being and dignity even in the humanitarian settings. The key output of this project is increased availability of and accessibility to life-saving SRHR, GBV and MHPSS services for affected populations, especially women and girls of reproductive age, delivered through service provision through static, mobile and remote modalities, provision of clean delivery kits and dignity kits, and community outreach to enhance the uptake of the services. The project will be implemented in partnership with following organizations: Relief International with Loi Tai Leng SHD, Shan State Development Foundation, Pa'oh Health Working Committee and Shwe Kanbawza, Premiere Urgence Internationale, People's Health Foundation, PATH with Myintmo Myitta Charity consotium, Karen Ethnic Health Organizations Consortium, Taw Oo Humanitarian and Development Organization, Future Light Dawei, Karuna Mission Social Solidarity Lashio, Disability Development Initiative, Women's Organization Network with Kuki Women's Human Rights Organization, Communities Partners International with Thandaunggyi Women's Group, Marie-Stope International Myanmar with Mandalar Yaung Shing, Finnish Refugee Council with the Institute of the Sisters of Reparation, and Arr Man Thit.
